text: The Rules of Procedure adopted by the Tribunal state that a Panel is 3 members and a quorum is 3 members The Tribunal may amend this. I believe the Panel should amend this to have each Panel consist of at least 4 members.
The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Requested the Tribunal Chair, in 2019 and 2020, to rotate the panel chair for each hearing of the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.
